mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals labor market deterioration, triggering a short-term sell-off in equities as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a broad-based economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS decreases and UNRATE increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), a federal funds rate increase signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25pp, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past quarter signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index below 100 (base 2017=100) indicates manufacturing weakness, triggering short-term equity sell-offs due to reduced corporate capital expenditure and earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a deepening economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth rate < 0 and RSAFS growth rate < 0
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth rate < 0 and RSAFS growth rate < 0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 1.5% YoY), a decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL < 1.5% and FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25pp, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
